label: late original-phase steps (t>=6) on l/3/r/g-like inputs, boosted by a/v/j/u-type earlier tokens
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase, at late absolute positions: none at t<=3, a little at t=4-5, most at t=6-8 (orig_idx 8 has a 21% rate). Because it depends on absolute position it is mostly seen in long sequences (L=9 holds 61% of mass), on the last or second-to-last original token. It never fires in the copy phase and only trivially at <DEL>. Within those positions, which token is input sets both firing and magnitude: l, 3, r and g are strongest (l alone is 23% of mass), then 2, x, h, e. Firing also goes up when the prefix has tokens like a, v, j, u, c, i, m, w, n, and first_tok=a/v/j has the highest rates. A first input that is the first occurrence of its token gets about a 5x higher rate than a repeat. Magnitude grows with position (higher at t=7-8 than at t=5-6). The prediction is a fuzzy mix of position, current token and prefix composition, and no clean predicate gets dev F1 above about 0.5: position alone gives recall 0.91 at precision 0.12.
